title: 第17章 演武苦修，缔约林霜
novel_title: 欠我时间债，天道也得跪着还
content_zh:
黑风岭南麓有一片乱石滩，石滩上寸草不生，只散落着几根歪歪扭扭的石柱。

    老猎户都绕道走，说那些石柱下面压着不干净的东西。

    苏余小时候跟他爹路过这片石滩，他爹说不是东西不干净，是风从石柱缝隙里穿过，发出的声音像鬼哭。

    现在苏余知道了。

    那不是风声。

    那是时族演武场的时痕共鸣——残留的时间之力在石柱间流动，发出的声音是无数个“瞬息”被撕碎又拼合的震颤。

    时之共鸣在这里格外强烈。

    苏余闭上眼睛，顺着共鸣的指引走到石滩中央一根半截埋在碎石里的石柱前。

    石柱上刻着模糊的篆文，字迹被风沙侵蚀了大半，但仍能辨认出几个字——“时族演武·第七阵·百倍”。

    他在基座上找到了一处凹陷，形状恰好与他手掌上的“时”字篆文吻合。

    将手背贴上去的瞬间，整个乱石滩震动了一下。

    那些歪扭的石柱忽然亮了起来，石柱表面浮现出密密麻麻的金色篆文，在半空中排列组合，形成了一座覆盖整片乱石滩的巨大阵图。

    阵图中心裂开一道缝隙，露出一条通向地下的石阶。

    苏余顺着石阶走下去。

    地下是一座极其空旷的石室，长宽约莫三十丈，高五丈，地面铺着整块的青石砖，砖面上刻满了深浅不一的脚印。

    石室四壁刻满了篆文，内容全是同一套拳法的口诀与图谱——第一式“破晓”，第二式“流光”，第三式“叠浪”，一直到第九式“归一”。

    时族炼体拳。

    苏白石说得对——若肉身太弱，时间之力会将身体直接压垮。

    这套拳法就是时族先祖为解决这个问题而创的，每一拳都暗合时间法则的运转规律。

    苏余花了半个时辰把四面墙上的口诀全部背下来。

    然后按照墙壁上的图谱摆出第一式破晓的起手姿势。

    他挥出了第一拳。

    拳风破空发出清脆炸响，但力是散的，没有从脚底到拳锋的贯通感。

    “你的腰没转到位。”

    一个声音忽然在他识海中响起。

    是苏玄恶念残留的最后一点意识碎片。

    “时族炼体拳不是靠蛮力打的。

    你看墙上那幅图——破晓的关键不在拳，在腰。

    腰是力道的枢纽，腰不转则力不通。”

    苏余重新摆好姿势，刻意放慢了速度。

    他先感受脚底蹬地的反作用力——那股力量从小腿上升到大腿，经过腰胯时他微微转动腰部，让力量沿着脊背向上穿过肩胛，最后从右拳的拳锋中爆发出去。

    这一拳的速度比刚才慢了至少一半，但力道反而更沉——拳风破空时不再是清脆的炸响，而是一种沉闷如雷的低鸣。

    石室内残留的时痕被这一拳引动，四面墙壁上的篆文微微发光，空气中浮现出无数细小的金色光点。

    “勉强算是入门了。

    当年时族嫡系子弟练破晓，最慢的一个花了三天才摸到门道。

    你用了不到一炷香。”

    苏玄恶念的声音里难得带了一丝欣慰，随即又恢复了惯常的刻薄，“不过别得意，后面八式一个比一个难。”

    从这天起，苏余在演武场里住了下来。

    白天在石室内练拳，晚上靠在石柱基座上打坐。
content_en:
There is a rocky beach at the southern foot of Heifeng Ridge. There is no grass growing on the rocky beach, only a few crooked stone pillars are scattered here and there.

    The old hunters all took a detour, saying that there was something unclean under the stone pillars.

    When Su Yu was a child, he passed by this rocky beach with his father. His father said it wasn't that the things were unclean, but that the wind passed through the gaps between the stone pillars, making a sound like a ghost crying.

    Now Su Yu knows.

    That's not a rumor.

    That was the resonance of time traces in the Time Clan's martial arts arena - the remaining power of time flowing between the stone pillars, and the sound it made was the tremor of countless "moments" being torn apart and put back together.

    The resonance of time is particularly strong here.

    Su Yu closed his eyes and followed the guidance of the resonance to a stone pillar half-buried in the gravel in the center of the stone beach.

    There are vague seal characters engraved on the stone pillars. Most of the writing has been eroded by the wind and sand, but a few words can still be made out - "Shi Clan Martial Arts·Seventh Formation·Hundred Times".

    He found a depression on the base, the shape of which coincided with the seal character "Shi" on his palm.

    The moment he put the back of his hand on it, the entire rocky beach shook.

    Those crooked stone pillars suddenly lit up, and dense golden seal characters appeared on the surface of the stone pillars. They were arranged and combined in mid-air, forming a huge formation covering the entire rocky beach.

    A gap opened in the center of the array, revealing a stone staircase leading underground.

    Su Yu walked down the stone steps.

    Underground is an extremely empty stone chamber, about thirty feet long and wide, five feet high. The ground is paved with whole bluestone bricks, and the bricks are covered with footprints of different shades.

    The walls of the stone chamber are covered with seal scripts, all of which contain formulas and diagrams of the same set of boxing techniques - the first form "Breaking Dawn", the second form "Liu Guang", the third form "Lai Lang", and all the way to the ninth form "Gui Yi".

    Shi Clan's Body Refining Boxing.

    Su Baishi is right - if the physical body is too weak, the power of time will directly crush the body.

    This set of boxing techniques was created by the ancestors of the Time Clan to solve this problem. Each punch coincides with the operation of the law of time.

    Su Yu spent half an hour memorizing all the formulas on the four walls.

    Then follow the chart on the wall to assume the first starting position of Daybreak.

    He threw the first punch.

    The wind from the fist broke through the air and made a crisp and explosive sound, but the force was scattered and there was no sense of penetration from the sole of the foot to the front of the fist.

    "Your waist is not turned in place."

    A voice suddenly sounded in his sea of consciousness.

    It was the last fragment of consciousness left by Su Xuan's evil thoughts.

    “Shi Clan Body Refining Boxing is not fought with brute force.

    Look at the picture on the wall - the key to breaking dawn is not the fists, but the waist.

    The waist is the hub of strength. If the waist is not turned, the strength will be blocked. "

    Su Yu repositioned himself and deliberately slowed down.

    He first felt the reaction force of the soles of his feet - the force rose from his calves to his thighs. When it passed through his waist and hips, he turned his waist slightly, letting the force go up along his back and through his shoulder blades, and finally burst out from the edge of his right fist.

    The speed of this punch was at least half slower than before, but the force was heavier - when the wind of the punch broke through the air, it was no longer a crisp explosion, but a low roar as dull as thunder.

    The remaining traces of time in the stone room were triggered by this punch, the seal characters on the four walls glowed slightly, and countless tiny golden light spots appeared in the air.

    “It’s barely an introduction.

    Back then, when the direct descendants of the Shi clan were practicing Po Xiao, it took the slowest one three days to figure it out.

    You used less than one stick of incense. "

    There was a rare hint of relief in Su Xuan's evil voice, and then he returned to his usual meanness, "But don't be complacent, each of the next eight moves is more difficult than the last."

    From that day on, Su Yu lived in the martial arts arena.

    He practiced boxing in the stone chamber during the day and meditated leaning on the stone pillar base at night.
